Backup writes a consistent copy of this host's database (agents, state,
messages, friction, history, jobs, everything agent stores) to
backups/gomuxai-<date>-<time>.db in the data directory, while agents keep
running. It prints the file. To restore one, stop the agents and the bus
and copy it over gomuxai.db.

Transcripts are the harnesses' files, and terminal logs are in logs/:
neither is in the database, so neither is in a backup.

--keep N then deletes all but the newest N backups this command made.

Usage:
  agent manage backup [flags]

Examples:
  agent manage backup
  agent manage backup --keep 5

Flags:
  -h, --help       help for backup
      --keep int   Afterwards, delete all but the newest N backups this command made (0: keep all)

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
